field_contract.verifier_version: Version of the behavior verifier contract.
field_contract.task_id: Stable task or fixture id when available.
field_contract.artifact_id: Artifact id when available, otherwise null.
field_contract.acceptance_criteria: Specific criteria that must be proven for product PASS.
field_contract.checks: Ordered check results, each with tier, label, expected, observed, and evidence.
field_contract.truth_label: Canonical truth label aligned with Phase 1.
field_contract.evidence_paths: Durable evidence files, screenshots, traces, or reports.
field_contract.unsupported_pass_reasons: Signals present but insufficient for product PASS.
field_contract.would_execute: False for preview-only and dry-run results.
field_contract.mutated_anything: False unless an explicitly approved future live proof mutates state.
field_contract.next_required_action: The next safe action for the operator or future phase.

check_result_shape.name: string
check_result_shape.status: PASS | FAIL | NEEDS_FIX | UNVERIFIED | BLOCKED | PARTIAL
